name: ai-engineering-from-scratch
description: Learn it. Build it. Ship it for others.
one_liner: A free, giant curriculum (500+ lessons) that teaches you AI engineering step by step, from math basics to building agents, with a real project to build at each step.
buyer: A corporate learning-and-development manager who needs to upskill a team of software engineers in AI/agent development quickly without building training from scratch.
business_use_cases: A bootcamp or university licenses/adapts the curriculum structure into a paid cohort-based course with mentorship.
A company's L&D team uses the free curriculum as the backbone for an internal 'AI upskilling' program for engineers.
A career coach builds paid 1:1 tutoring or code-review services on top of learners working through this free material.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a paid cohort version with live mentorship, code review, and a certificate on top of the free open-source lessons.
Offer a paid corporate training package that customizes the curriculum's learning paths for a specific company's tech stack.

steal_this: Launch a $199 4-week cohort this weekend that walks a small group through the 'Agent Engineering' phase live, using this repo as the free syllabus and charging for structure and accountability.
